title: Committed Chough records can leak local paths, names and credentials (#234)
symptom: a home-folder path, user or host name, email or credential in a session value is written into a committed record
trigger: Record a checkpoint decision whose text holds a path inside a home folder
expected: the write is refused naming the field and kind, or redacted with --redact, with every file unchanged on refusal
actual: the value is written into the committed session record
steps: chough checkpoint --decision with a home-folder path in its text
impact: Personal and machine details reach the repository and its history (GitHub #234)
source: GitHub issue #234; red on 0.5.0 at leif/0.6.0-batch-red 370d221d

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Session and bug writes fixed in plans steps 3 and 5 (PR #238); the case passed after its 0.5.0 failure. The doctor scan and the verify lane's leaks step (t37j) join this case when they land.
